findings.finding: OPA1678 on single 5.1 V: at 0 dBFS the + input peaks at 3.05 V vs common-mode limit V+-2 = 3.10 V; output swings 0.92..4.18 V vs 0.8..4.3 V. Distortion near full scale; margin negative below 5.03 V supply.

Proposed loopback switch (second TS5A23157) on the RCA side would switch LDIV, which is ground-referenced (0 V DC, +/-0.92 Vpk with FLX4 2.1 Vrms): below the switch's 0..V+ signal range; body diodes conduct, distorting the ADC and DJ-direct paths.
findings.evidence: SCDS165F 6.5 analog range 0..V+, abs min -0.5 V; LDIV = 2.1*1.414*0.311 = 0.92 Vpk

findings.finding: Proposed loopback switch select from a 3.3 V ESP32 GPIO or ES9018K2M GPIO2 cannot reach TS5A23157 VIH = 0.7*V+ = 3.57 V at 5.1 V; ES9018 GPIO is tri-stated during RESETB low (select floats).
findings.evidence: SCDS165F 6.5 VIH V+*0.7; ES9018K2M v3.7 p.9 standby tri-states GPIO

findings.finding: SDZ driven from GPIO21 (3.3 V) through R54 100k. SLOS708G allows IIH up to 50 uA; above 13 uA SDZ falls below VIH 2.0 V and the amp never leaves shutdown.
findings.evidence: SLOS708G 6.3: VIH 2 V, IIH 50 uA max; 3.3 V - 50 uA*100k = -1.7 V (worst case), needs I <= 13 uA
